verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers campaign results export, link-click reporting, engagement timing, and read-only domain verification status. None of it documents per-send bounce, complaint, or blocklist signals, or any guidance when deliverability degrades. Domain verification status and generic campaign results are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can see bounce, complaint, and blocklist signals per send and get actionable guidance when deliverability degrades
